name: fastcar
//scripts: These delegate by cd-ing into the workspace rather than with npm's --workspace flag: bun rewrites `npm run` to `bun run` and then ignores --workspace, which re-runs the identically-named ROOT script and recurses forever. `cd <dir> && npm run <script>` resolves against the workspace's own package.json under every package manager.

scripts.validate-agents: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const content=fs.readFileSync('agents.yaml','utf8'); if(content.includes('agents:')) console.log('agents.yaml valid'); else console.warn('agents.yaml missing agents key');"
scripts.build: (cd shared && npm run build) && (cd web && npm run build) && (cd server && npm run build)
scripts.typecheck: (cd shared && npm run typecheck) && (cd server && npm run typecheck) && (cd web && npm run typecheck)
